title: Greatest Common Divisor and Least Common Multiple
description: Given two positive integers `a` and `b`, calculate their Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) and Least Common Multiple (LCM).
hints: Use Euclidean algorithm: `gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a % b)`.
LCM is derived from: `lcm(a, b) = (a * b) // gcd(a, b)`.
Python's `math.gcd` computes GCD in logarithmic time.

reference_solution:
import sys, math
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    a, b = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    g = math.gcd(a, b)
    l = (a * b) // g
    print(f'{g} {l}')
